housing: Grand Rapids' rentals are mostly older wood-frame houses and duplexes, many built before 1978, plus newer downtown apartments.

localRules.text: Grand Rapids requires a Certificate of Compliance for every rental unit not lived in by its owner, and no one can move in until it is issued.
As part of rental certification, the city screens rentals built before 1978 for lead hazards.

fact: Heritage Hill is one of the largest urban historic districts in the country, and many of its big old houses are now apartments.
